+++ b/internal/tracing/tracing.go
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	// Environment attributes may override the default service name, while the
+	// running binary determines its service version.
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt")),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion)),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a tracer provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(res),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for the given configuration. Each call owns
+// its exporter and shutdown function, so callers can use different configurations.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing config is nil")
+	}
+
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err := jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, nil, err
+		}
+		return managedExporter(exp)
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err := zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, nil, err
+		}
+		return managedExporter(exp)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		client, err := otlpClient(cfg.OTLP)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, nil, err
+		}
+		exp, err := otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, nil, err
+		}
+		return managedExporter(exp)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+}
+
+// The provider's span processor also shuts down its exporter. Share the same
+// shutdown operation with the callback registered by the server lifecycle.
+type exporterWithShutdown struct {
+	tracesdk.SpanExporter
+	once sync.Once
+	err  error
+}
+
+func (e *exporterWithShutdown) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
+	e.once.Do(func() { e.err = e.SpanExporter.Shutdown(ctx) })
+	return e.err
+}
+
+func managedExporter(exp tracesdk.SpanExporter) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	managed := &exporterWithShutdown{SpanExporter: exp}
+	return managed, managed.Shutdown, nil
+}
+
+func otlpClient(cfg config.OTLPTracingConfig) (otlptrace.Client, error) {
+	endpoint := cfg.Endpoint
+	if endpoint == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: empty endpoint")
+	}
+
+	if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
+		if err := validateHostPort(endpoint); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(endpoint),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	}
+
+	u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+	}
+	if u.Hostname() == "" || strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: invalid URL", endpoint)
+	}
+	if u.Port() != "" {
+		if err := validateHostPort(u.Host); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case "http", "https":
+		opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+			otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+		}
+		if u.Scheme == "http" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+		}
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+		}
+		return otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...), nil
+	case "grpc":
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: gRPC endpoint cannot contain a path", endpoint)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: unsupported scheme %q", endpoint, u.Scheme)
+	}
+}
+
+func validateHostPort(endpoint string) error {
+	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if host == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("missing host")
+	}
+	n, err := strconv.Atoi(port)
+	if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 65535 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("invalid port %q", port)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"

+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+
+	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	requireAttribute(t, res.Set(), semconv.ServiceNameKey, "flipt")
+	requireAttribute(t, res.Set(), semconv.ServiceVersionKey, "1.2.3")
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "overridden")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "deployment.environment=dev,service.name=from-attributes,service.version=from-attributes")
+	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), "2.0.0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	requireAttribute(t, res.Set(), semconv.ServiceNameKey, "overridden")
+	requireAttribute(t, res.Set(), semconv.ServiceVersionKey, "2.0.0")
+	requireAttribute(t, res.Set(), attribute.Key("deployment.environment"), "dev")
+}
+
+func requireAttribute(t *testing.T, set *attribute.Set, key attribute.Key, expected string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	value, ok := set.Value(key)
+	require.True(t, ok, "missing attribute %s", key)
+	require.Equal(t, expected, value.AsString())
+}
+
+func TestNewProviderSamples(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	require.True(t, span.IsRecording())
+	require.True(t, span.SpanContext().IsSampled())
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"otlp http", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"otlp https", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317"}}},
+		{"otlp grpc", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317"}}},
+		{"otlp host:port", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317"}}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tt.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.NotNil(t, exp)
+			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
+			provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exp))
+			require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+			require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+			require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetExporterIndependentCalls(t *testing.T) {
+	bad := config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &bad)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported tracing exporter: 99")
+
+	cfg := config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}
+	first, firstShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	second, secondShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotSame(t, first, second)
+	require.NoError(t, firstShutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, secondShutdown(context.Background()))

+func TestOTLPHTTPHeadersAndPath(t *testing.T) {
+	requests := make(chan *http.Request, 1)
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-protobuf")
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+
+	cfg := config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+		Endpoint: srv.URL + "/custom/traces",
+		Headers:  map[string]string{"X-Test-Header": "configured"},
+	}}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background())) }()
+
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exp))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "send")
+	span.End()
+	require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+
+	select {
+	case request := <-requests:
+		require.Equal(t, "/custom/traces", request.URL.Path)
+		require.Equal(t, "configured", request.Header.Get("X-Test-Header"))
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("OTLP exporter did not send a request")
+	}
+}
